behavior.epilogue: canary check (fs:0x28 at rsp+0x18), mutex unlock, return void
behavior.lock: mutex at outer+0x18 locked first; nonzero lock result throws system_error
behavior.on_append_position: when the key is greater than the last element, the pair is appended at the end with no shift
behavior.on_empty_vector: appends the new (key, 1) pair at the begin/end
behavior.on_equal: increments the matched element's count field (+0x08) by 1, unlocks, returns
behavior.on_full_vector: when end equals capacity, the growth helper 0x5160790 is called with (outer, pair pointer) and inserts the pair; the window then takes the normal unlock epilogue
behavior.on_middle_insert: the tail from the insert position is shifted right by 16 bytes (single 16-byte copy for a one-element tail, memmove otherwise), then the pair is stored at the insert position
behavior.search: walks from the vector end toward the begin, comparing the key against each element; steps toward the begin while the element exceeds the key (AT&T cmp element-minus-key, jae taken), stops at the first element smaller than the key
behavior.on_less_than_all: inserts the new (key, 1) pair at the begin
behavior.on_greater_than_element: inserts the new (key, 1) pair immediately after that element

caller_enclosure.args_at_call: rdi = field at caller-struct +0x1698, rsi = key in r15
caller_enclosure.role: census only; the enclosing routine is not modeled here

caller_census.method: full .text e8/e9 scans plus whole-file qword scan

exception_cleanup.lock_failure_path: 0x5160aa7: canary check, then throw_system_error with the lock result

growth_callee.contract: called with (outer in rdi, pair pointer in rdx) only when end equals capacity; inserts the pair itself; caller takes the unlock epilogue on return
growth_callee.note: callee only; its internals are not pinned by this item

observations_not_claims: The caller passes a +0x1698 field as the counted-key struct; the same +0x1698 offset appears for the pending-erase sweep's site-3 caller in PR #1798. Whether the two structs are the same object is NOT claimed.
The key's semantic type is not claimed; it is compared unsigned and stored verbatim.
The count field wraps modulo 2^64 under the addq increment; the model masks to 64 bits.
